en: How do I change my WhatsApp name?

steps: Name reviewed by Meta; decision stored as name_status; verified name updated on approval
edgeCases: Rules: reflect real business, close to website/papers, no generic words, no emoji/punctuation/"WhatsApp"
Change/resubmit is done in Meta WhatsApp settings, not in Ebda Chat
gaps: name_status exists in DB but NumbersScreen does not show it (verify)
No in-product way to request a name change
